name: talaria
description: Talaria — the operations platform for companies that run on people and AI agents. This root package is the RUNNER HUB: every way to drive the repo, from one place, on Bun.

scripts.typecheck: cd ui && bun run typecheck && cd ../mcp && bun run typecheck
scripts.api:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml --quiet
scripts.desktop:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --quiet && cd desktop && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun scripts/check-invariants.mjs && bun scripts/check-docs.mjs && bun scripts/gen-docs.mjs --check && bun scripts/check-mcp-routes.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
